limits: local Linux shaped network is not actual Internet WAN
captured wire bytes are whole-session only
CPU domains are process or labeled nested stages; never add nested stages to process totals
client wall includes waiting and overlapping CPU, isolated send-only time is not identified
runtime/warm are explicit object profiles, not transparent TUN compression
artifact custody and source/binary identity are independently verified
method: analysis-method.md; three descriptive paired trials; ratios are candidate/baseline, lower is better; no confidence or tail claims
